text: Kaal stipulates two constructs: Agentic Decoupling, the progressive severance of value creation from human labor and consumption, and the Coasean Singularity, the point at which the theoretical justification for hierarchical governance disappears.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442
